rules.name: critical_new_device_large_transfer
rules.description: High-value transfer attempted from a newly observed device.
rules.condition: event.event_type == 'transaction_initiated' and event.amount and event.amount > 2500 and features.new_device_flag

rules.name: password_reset_then_high_value_transfer
rules.description: Recent password reset immediately followed by a large transaction.
rules.condition: event.event_type == 'transaction_initiated' and features.password_reset_recent_flag and event.amount and event.amount > 1500
